title: Antaguanjun Tengchong Gaoligong Ultra 2026 — MGU 168 km results
claims: ITRA lists the 2026 Tengchong Gaoligong Ultra MGU 168 km on 20–22 March 2026, with Mountain Level 7 and Finisher Level 410.
The MGU 168 km men's top three are Zhang Weiqiang 21:48:08, Liu Peng 22:36:17 and Li Song 22:56:23.
ITRA's result page is an organiser-submitted record, not the race's own live timing page.
The MGU 168 km women's top three are Chi Lingjie 24:40:24, Zhao Fufen 25:29:59 and Qin Meiqing 26:04:15.
ITRA's 2026 MGU result block records 565 total participants, 428 finishers and 137 DNFs.
